description.value: True Grain is an organic craft bakery that has been handcrafting sourdough loaves, pastries, and cookies in the seaside village of Cowichan Bay since 2004, using 100% BC-farmed organic grain that the team stone-mills on-site in the Cowichan Valley. The bakery follows a farm-to-mill-to-baker model rooted in European tradition, working with ancient and heritage grains like Einkorn, Emmer, Spelt, and Red Fife with no additives or preservatives. It has grown into a destination for bread lovers exploring Vancouver Island, with in-store pickup, local home delivery, and Canada-wide mail order available.
